blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Today, we will learn about a rap group's story. We will follow their early days, their work, and their final show.

items.prompt: What music do you listen to?
Do you prefer one rapper or a group?

blocks.title: Part 1: A Crew of Friends
paragraphs: **BAD HOP were a hip-hop crew of eight rappers from Kawasaki.** A crew is a group of people who work together. Rappers speak words with the beat of the music.
**They started the group in 2014.** They were friends long before they became a music group.
**Twin brothers T-Pablow and YZERR were at the centre of the group.** Twins are two children born to the same mother at the same time. The brothers helped lead the crew and make its music.

images.alt: The eight members of BAD HOP standing together on a street in Kawasaki

blocks.title: Check: Part 1: A Crew of Friends

items.prompt: What connected the members before they made music together?

blocks.title: Part 2: Growing Up with Rap
paragraphs: **The friends grew up in a difficult part of Kawasaki.** Money was a problem in their area. Rap gave them a way to tell people about their lives.
**T-Pablow started rapping as a teenager.** In 2012, he won the BAZOOKA!!! High School Rap Championship. It was a rap battle contest for young rappers.
**In a rap battle, people take turns rapping against each other.** They make up their words as they rap. The words are not from a song they learned before.

images.alt: Two teenage rappers taking turns with microphones during a rap battle

blocks.title: Check: Part 2: Growing Up with Rap

items.prompt: Did the rappers use words from a song they had learned?
items.answer: No. They made up their words as they rapped.

blocks.title: Part 3: Doing It Themselves
paragraphs: **BAD HOP worked independently, without a big record company behind them.** Here, independent means doing the work and making the decisions yourself. They had to do more than write songs.
**In 2018, they gave a concert at Nippon Budokan in Tokyo.** A concert is a show where people perform music for other people. All the tickets sold.
**They organised the concert themselves and paid its costs.** That meant finding the money to put the show on. Their work included the business side of music.

images.alt: The Nippon Budokan building in Tokyo, with fans walking towards its entrance

items.prompt: Who organised and paid for the concert?

blocks.title: Part 4: The Final Concert
paragraphs: **BAD HOP gave their final concert at Tokyo Dome in February 2024.** They were the first Japanese hip-hop group to headline their own concert there. Headline means being the main act at a show.
**The group ended after that night.** Fans heard old songs and new music during the concert. The music brought parts of their story together in one show.
**Later, YZERR released new music under his own name.** He continued his story as a rapper after the group ended.

images.alt: BAD HOP performing before a large audience inside Tokyo Dome at their final concert

items.prompt: What did YZERR do after BAD HOP ended?
items.answer: He released new music under his own name.
